from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Inches, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

NAVY = RGBColor(0x1F,0x2A,0x44)

def new_doc():
    d = Document()
    sec = d.sections[0]
    sec.left_margin = sec.right_margin = Inches(1)
    sec.top_margin = sec.bottom_margin = Inches(0.9)
    st = d.styles['Normal']; st.font.name = 'Calibri'; st.font.size = Pt(10.5)
    st.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn('w:eastAsia'), 'Calibri')
    st.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(6)
    for lvl, sz in ((1,13),(2,11.5),(3,10.5)):
        h = d.styles['Heading %d' % lvl]; h.font.name='Calibri'; h.font.size=Pt(sz); h.font.bold=True
        h.font.color.rgb = NAVY
        h.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn('w:eastAsia'), 'Calibri')
        h.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(12 if lvl==1 else 8); h.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(4)
    # footer page number
    p = sec.footer.paragraphs[0]; p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    r = p.add_run('Privileged & Confidential - Attorney-Client Communication / Attorney Work Product - Page ')
    r.font.size = Pt(8)
    _field(p, 'PAGE')
    return d

def _field(p, code):
    r = p.add_run(); r.font.size = Pt(8)
    a = OxmlElement('w:fldChar'); a.set(qn('w:fldCharType'),'begin')
    b = OxmlElement('w:instrText'); b.set(qn('xml:space'),'preserve'); b.text = code
    c = OxmlElement('w:fldChar'); c.set(qn('w:fldCharType'),'end')
    r._r.append(a); r._r.append(b); r._r.append(c)

def rich(p, text):
    # **bold** markup
    parts = text.split('**')
    for i, s in enumerate(parts):
        if not s: continue
        r = p.add_run(s)
        if i % 2 == 1: r.bold = True
    return p

def para(d, text, style=None, align=None, size=None, italic=False, after=None):
    p = d.add_paragraph(style=style) if style else d.add_paragraph()
    rich(p, text)
    if align == 'center': p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    if align == 'justify': p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY
    if size or italic:
        for r in p.runs:
            if size: r.font.size = Pt(size)
            if italic: r.italic = True
    if after is not None: p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(after)
    return p

def bullets(d, items, style='List Bullet'):
    for it in items:
        p = d.add_paragraph(style=style); rich(p, it)
        p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(3)

def numbered(d, items):
    bullets(d, items, 'List Number')

def shade(cell, hexcolor):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    s = OxmlElement('w:shd'); s.set(qn('w:val'),'clear'); s.set(qn('w:color'),'auto'); s.set(qn('w:fill'),hexcolor)
    tcPr.append(s)

def table(d, header, rows, widths=None, size=8.5, hl=None):
    t = d.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(header))
    t.style = 'Table Grid'; t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    for i, h in enumerate(header):
        c = t.rows[0].cells[i]; c.text = ''
        r = c.paragraphs[0].add_run(h); r.bold = True; r.font.size = Pt(size); r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF,0xFF,0xFF)
        shade(c, '1F2A44')
    # repeat header row
    trPr = t.rows[0]._tr.get_or_add_trPr(); th = OxmlElement('w:tblHeader'); th.set(qn('w:val'),'true'); trPr.append(th)
    for ri, row in enumerate(rows):
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i, v in enumerate(row):
            c = cells[i]; c.text = ''
            rich(c.paragraphs[0], str(v))
            for p in c.paragraphs:
                p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)
                for r in p.runs: r.font.size = Pt(size)
            if hl and hl(ri, row): shade(c, 'FCE4E4')
            elif ri % 2 == 1: shade(c, 'F2F4F8')
    if widths:
        for row in t.rows:
            for i, w in enumerate(widths):
                row.cells[i].width = Inches(w)
    d.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t
